label: drone brood removal
description: Cutting out capped drone brood, where Varroa prefers to reproduce, to take mites out of the colony without chemicals.

sources.title: Drone brood trapping as integrated pest management
sources.author: Lindqvist, M.

claims.text: Mechanical control alone did not prevent viral amplification in high-pressure years.

relations.text: Drone brood removal reduced mite load by 43% relative to untreated controls.
